theorems.name: Submission.imc_approxTangent_iff_of_subset
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (E E' : Set (Eucl N)), E ⊆ E' → NullMeasurableSet E (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → NullMeasurableSet E' (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) (E' ∩ K) < ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict E), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E x Q ↔ Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E' x Q
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
